members.canonical_role: routing and delivery umbrella governing distinct route primitives
members.role: Bounded priority admission, idempotency, leases, fencing, bounded retry and dead-letter state.

hard_invariants: The entire pack is CONTROLLED_TEST, has no external-effect adapter binding and enables no external effects.
Admission is bounded and an idempotency key cannot silently change its request.
Admission payloads and public claim payloads are detached, deeply immutable runtime custody values.
Priority, attempts, timestamps and all internal-unit fields reject booleans; max_attempts is at most 100 and unit values are at most 9223372036854775807.
Claim custody requires an active fenced lease and a current exact-scope authority receipt, but never authorizes an external effect.
Authority receipts bind an allowlisted issuer, the exact runtime environment and the receipt evidence fields; the binding digest is not an issuer signature or authentication proof.
Authority receipt, lease and load-TTL validity use exclusive upper bounds; authority expiry caps lease expiry and revocation fails subsequent validation closed.
Every active claim must exactly reproduce its job, worker, route, fencing token, lease expiry, attempt, immutable payload, receipt and reservation bindings.
Every active reservation must exactly reproduce its reservation id, job, fencing token, route and admitted estimate units.
A route cost ceiling is checked and reserved before a job lease is created.
Missing, disabled, future-dated or expired load evidence cannot increase throughput.
At-capacity routes produce backpressure rather than unbounded admission or dispatch.
Retries are bounded; exhaustion and repeated lease expiry end in dead-letter state.

Completion requires an explicit operation, non-negative bounded quantity, exact immutable PentaRate object, usage evidence reference and result; metered usage binds the job, route, fence, reservation and result digest.
Completion is local implementation verification only and has no certification, provider-write, vote, quorum or production-promotion effect.
Queue history, idempotency history, reservations, usage, operational ledger entries and exception evidence have explicit retention ceilings and fail closed before evidence would be dropped.
Every completion rate must exactly match a preconfigured immutable rate-book id/version/digest, be effective at completion time and meter no more units than the active admitted reservation.
A runtime stop irreversibly disables new admission for that instance while preserving bounded failure and lease-reap recovery paths.
Every schema-bound runtime object and readback has a detached plain-JSON serializer and validates against the supplied Draft 2020-12 schema.
Exception consolidation preserves exact counts and one output record per retained input while redacting sensitive report values and publishing digests of their unredacted source values.
PentaCosts uses internal integer estimate units and exposes no payment, transfer, settlement, pricing, treasury or accounting action.
PentaRate versions are immutable; rate lookup never mutates a prior version.
PentaMeter and PentaCostLedger append idempotent operational evidence rather than rewriting history.
All PentaCosts family arithmetic is bounded to non-negative signed 64-bit integer units and fails on overflow.
PentaForecast is advisory only and can never reserve a budget or authorize spend.

runtime_model.retention_policy: explicit bounded capacities fail closed before history or evidence is dropped
runtime_model.rate_configuration: preconfigured immutable id/version/digest with effective-time and reservation-ceiling checks
runtime_model.stop_control: irreversible per-runtime admission stop; failure and reap remain enabled
runtime_model.wire_contract: plain JSON serializers validated against Draft 2020-12
runtime_model.durable_multiworker_binding: requires an independently governed transactional state adapter

cost_family_boundary.PentaCosts: compatibility facade composing the operational family while preserving the v1 budget API
cost_family_boundary.PentaMeter: append-only idempotent usage records bound to an exact rate-book digest
cost_family_boundary.PentaBudget: atomic explicit per-route ceiling, reservation, release and accounted-use status
cost_family_boundary.PentaCostLedger: append-only operational reservation entries; not accounting or treasury source of truth
cost_family_boundary.PentaForecast: advisory ceiling-mean integer projection; never spend authority
cost_family_boundary.PentaCost_identity_boundary: The institutional penta.cost / PentaCost system is separate from this pack's penta.costs / PentaCosts component; neither aliases, supersedes nor replaces the other.

promotion_rule: This pack remains CONTROLLED_TEST until an independent verifier, exact-head CI, durable adapter tests, provider readback where applicable, rollback evidence and the governing release mechanism support a narrower state. The pack cannot promote itself.
rollback: Disable new admission, stop effect preflight, allow safe failure/reap paths, preserve raw exceptions and claims, release only unaccounted reservations, and restore the previous exact runtime version through reviewed source history.
